lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: All clear. Material H is no longer active.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text:
Phew... 
At least we've taken care of the urgent part.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Don't you think it's a bit odd?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Didn't Enikk say all the Ark's forces were coming here?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Enikk. Give me a status report.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Before we know it, the walls come tumbling down.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: As the last remnants of the wall come down, the sight behind it is revealed to be... the Ark.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: They fashioned a room! It's an illusion?!

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Material H has conjured up an entire road before.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: So that thing we just took out...

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Was an illusion, meant to distract us.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: a Nikke wearing golden armor stares at us.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: No. It's assumed the form of a Nikke, but it's no Nikke.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Malice honed to a razor-sharp edge,

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Nihilister comes soaring down in a flurry of flame.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Two Heretics, together in the Ark.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: It's as Enikk said: the worst situation imaginable.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: It almost doesn't feel real. More like a nightmare.

lines.speaker: nihilister_a
lines.text:
It's been a while. 
How are you doing?

lines.speaker: nihilister_a
lines.text: Small wonder, considering how many Nikkes you gorged on.

lines.speaker: nihilister_a
lines.text: Those poor saps kept coming like a conveyer belt. They might as well have been begging, "Please, eat me!"

lines.speaker: nihilister_a
lines.text:
Of course. 
The Ark is full of Nikkes.

lines.speaker: nihilister_a
lines.text: How about we start with these ones?

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: but I can't quite make it out.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Suddenly, Anis's body is split in two.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: so there should be no more absorption function.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: I can't believe I'm using a sword instead of a tentacle - what a fool!

lines.speaker: nihilister_a
lines.text: Well, forget it. You can take your time to get familiar with it.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text:
Look at that Heretic's tail.
It's in the shape of a sword.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: That's what got Anis and Neon. It's incredibly fast, so be careful.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text:
It's okay. 
They're not dead yet.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: If we're not too late, they can live.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Is there a way to take this thing down?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The Matis and Absolute Squad are en route to your location, but it will be 20 minutes before they arrive.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Even with their assistance, your victory is far from assured.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: She is setting up a sniper's nest 1km away.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: There's a brief flash of white.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: The light is aimed at Nihilister and Indivilia, but

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: a looming shadow suddenly manifests and blocks the projectile.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: When it makes contact with the shadow, the light instantly dissipates.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Something about that shadow seems familiar...

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: Meeting you in the Ark brings back memories.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: How are things? Have you been well?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: I was until you showed up.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: Hahaha! So sorry to disappoint you!

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Cover me. I'll buy us some time.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Mark the closest ejection elevators going up from the Ark to the surface.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Dorothy and I will drive the Heretics and Chatterbox over there.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Once we get them trapped in one of the elevators, send it up and blow up the shaft leading up to the surface.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: There's no way that plan will work.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Operating level increasing to limit of sub-generator.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Rapi's head starts to glow red.

lines.speaker: notification
lines.text: After that, control must be transferred to another host

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Rapi takes off in a flash, leaving a phantom trail of crimson behind her.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: What in holy mother of f...

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Chatterbox tries to land a haymaker,

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: but Rapi swings her own fist directly into the punch.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Rapi grabs Chatterbox by the head and hurls it in the air, sending it flying towards Nihilister.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Chatterbox careens into Nihilister with a loud bang, sending the two of them tumbling to the ground in a heap.

lines.speaker: nihilister_a
lines.text: What the hell is going on?!

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Indivilia's tail darts through the air.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Rapi catches the end of Indivilia's tail with her hands.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Rapi breaks off the sharp tip of Indivilia's tail,

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: takes the newly acquired blade in her hand, and stabs Indivilia in the stomach.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Rapi turns and delivers a swift roundhouse kick to Indivilia.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Indivilia is sent hurling through the air, and collides with Chatterbox and Nihilister just as they're finally getting themselves untangled from each other.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: The three Raptures are now one interlocked pile of mish-mashed parts, rolling along the ground.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Rapi and Dorothy rush towards the dogpile and keep pushing the three Raptures forward.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Storefront after storefront is shattered to pieces, sending entire buildings collapsing to the ground.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Rapi and Dorothy continue to move forward.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: After a few moments, Dorothy starts to lag behind.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: One of the elevators opens. Rapi and four others enter.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: As the elevator doors slide shut,

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Rapi turns back to look at me.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: I watch as it soars higher and higher.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_c
lines.text: Route has been destroyed and cordoned off.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_c
lines.text: have been ejected from the Ark.
